QUESTION: How do record time and arrival time distinguish delayed delivery from stale
     consumption?
     PROMPT: DIAGRAM: Two aligned diagnostic cases with Record produced and Destination receives
     markers. Case A: old record time, recent arrival, with a long buffered interval at the host and
     a recent delivery arrow; label Check host buffering/reconnection. Case B: old record time and
     old arrival time, with no new delivery marker; label Check whether destination is rereading old
     data. These are investigative leads, not proof of root cause. Use visibly different symbols for
     the two clocks and a broken time axis; do not substitute aggregate latency for individual
     timestamps.

     fleet/fleets, including headings and labels. Do not call these groups teams. Preserve
     exact code/API identifiers. These instructions are not text to render.

     vehicles. Use Inter labels and Roboto Mono identifiers. At 1400 px source width use 48 px
     titles, 36 px body labels, and at least 28 px secondary text; scale proportionally. Check at
     720 px reading width and intended print size. Use a 32 px spacing grid, at least 24 px node

     to 20 to 25 percent; full strength is for small marks. Keep text navy or slate, or off-white on
